statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope
The patient has paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0)
The patient has sick sinus syndrome (I49.5)
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction (Z86.73)
CPT 93229 mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring was billed
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial was based on failure to obtain required precertification or authorization prior to the service date
Continuous ambulatory monitoring is indicated to detect arrhythmic events and guide anticoagulation and rate-control management
